title: Trochoidal slot leaves a post at its start when the loop band is wider than the tool

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
Found while working #1509.

What happens: the stand-alone Trochoidal slot bores its entry helix on a circle of the loop band's half-width `b = (W - D) / 2 - leave` about the centre line's start (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/trochoid_bore.rs`, the plain bore; before #1509's PR the same code in `trochoid_slot.rs`, `emit_level`). A helix of radius `b` clears the ring `b +- r`. With `b > r` (a slot wider than twice the tool: W > 2 D) a post of radius `b - r` is left standing at the bore's centre, full depth. No front arc reaches it (the loops only advance away from the bore), the operation reports OK, and the verifier has nothing to say (uncut material is not a gouge).

Evidence: on a band of half-width 4.9 mm with a 6 mm tool (post radius 1.9 mm), the plain bore leaves more than 4 mm2 standing inside a 1.4 mm disc about the start, read on the dexel stock (`quality::rest_area`); the test `the_opened_bore_leaves_no_post_at_the_lane_start` in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive_troch_tests.rs` asserts it for the plain bore and its absence for the opened one. The maintainer's #1503 screenshot (W 16, D 6: b = 5, r = 3) has a 2 mm radius post at A.

Expected: no post. The 2D Adaptive trochoidal method already opens its bore (`trochoid_bore::bore` with `open: true`: helix at half the tool radius, then a two-centre semicircle spiral out to the band, read by the same engagement measurement). The stand-alone slot can take the same bore; that moves its output for W > 2 D (its golden `trochoid_slot_small.cl` has b < r and does not move).

Done means: a Trochoidal slot with W > 2 D leaves no standing material inside its channel at the start (a rest reading in the motion suite), the engagement limit still holds, and slots with b <= r post byte-identically.
